# `core/profiler/GameplayProfiler.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/profiler/GameplayProfiler.js`

GameplayProfiler.js - Real-Time Performance Analysis System Based on Unity/industry best practices: - Uses frame TIME (ms) not FPS for accuracy - Tracks percentiles (P95/P99) to catch stutters - Identifies CPU vs GPU bound scenarios - Throughput testing over real gameplay - Detects thermal throttling and memory trends Modes: - QUICK: 30 seconds (fast check) - SPAWN: 2 minutes (initial load stress test) - EXTENDED: 5 minutes (sustained + thermal throttling) - STRESS: Run particle/fluid/chunk stress tests ⚠️ MULTIPLAYER: Uses deterministic RNG from AIRandom.js
